release_notes: **Dhan market-feed pacing widened from 1.0s to 1.3s**: spacing `ltp()`/`quote()` calls exactly at Dhan's documented 1 req/s left no margin for network jitter, and prod 429s kept landing on the 1.0s-spaced second call of an ltp+quote pair. Every market-feed call (including retries) now waits 1.3s after the previous one, across all processes. **Breeze empty `quote()` no longer suppresses profit exits**: Breeze's own daily-call-cap guard (3,500) made `quote()` return `{}` instead of raising, so the illiquid-leg check read "no rows" as "no market" and skipped the fail-open path — silently suppressing a real profit exit. An empty `quote()` is now treated as a failed call; a missing row next to live rows for other legs is still flagged. Also raises the default `brokers.breeze.daily_call_cap` 3500 → 6000 since 09-21 and 09-28 both tripped it with no ICICI-side rejection.
